HistoricalReconstructionAssessment.Decision: Do not reconstruct or fill Cargo values. Any replay from historical Wikitext would be a separate synthetic/current-state experiment unless independently validated against a historical Cargo dataset.

HistoricalParity.Rule: Requires revision-correlated Cargo rows and matching source dependencies.

CurrentStateCompatibility.Rule: Must use current-state source material and must not be reported as historical parity.

SyntheticImplementationTesting.Rule: Synthetic rows may exercise bounded provider/worker/rendering behavior, but results are not authentic source equivalence.
